name: Retail Store
description: Starter pack for retail stores: opening and closing checklists, stock control, shrink review and licenses.

definitions.title: Closing checklist
steps: Count tills and secure the safe
Log anything left for the morning shift

definitions.title: Weekly stock take
definitions.note: Count fast-moving stock and place replenishment orders.

definitions.title: Weekly merchandising refresh
definitions.note: Refresh displays and promotional end-caps for the week.

definitions.title: Monthly price and planogram audit
definitions.note: Check shelf prices against the planogram and correct gaps.

definitions.title: Monthly fire and alarm test
definitions.note: Test the fire alarm, emergency lights and extinguishers.

definitions.title: Quarterly shrink review
definitions.note: Compare stock loss against sales and investigate patterns.

definitions.title: Business license renewal
definitions.note: Renew the business license before year end.

definitions.title: Lease renewal review
definitions.note: Review the lease terms and decide renewal or negotiation.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc equipment repair
definitions.note: Repair or service call for store equipment - set the due date when creating it.
